title: COUP-TFII mediates progesterone regulation of uterine implantation by controlling ER activity
key_use: Mouse PR-Cre conditional COUP-TFII (Nr2f2) knockout; FULL TEXT INSPECTED 2026-07-30. Supports exactly one chain and no more: epithelial Ihh acts on stromal COUP-TFII, COUP-TFII is required for BMP2 induction, and intrauterine BMP2 add-back RESCUES the decidual response in the mutant - a genuine rescue, which is rare in this corpus. Loss of stromal COUP-TFII also produces enhanced epithelial oestrogen activity, persistent MUC1 and failure of the uterus to become receptive. Caveats first: entirely mouse in vivo, so every use is a species transfer against a human target model, and the knockout is PR-Cre driven, i.e. deleted in both stroma and epithelium wherever PR is expressed, so compartment attribution rests on the reported expression pattern rather than on a compartment-restricted driver. Decidualization is artificially stimulated, not embryo-driven, in the rescue arm. Scope limits that are load-bearing for citation: HAND2 occurs ZERO times and FGF occurs ZERO times in the full text, so this paper cannot support any HAND2 or FGF relation (LE044, LE045, LE092, LE093, LE094) and those citations are retracted under full_text_absence. It also reports no adhesion, attachment or embryo-adhesion endpoint. What it does newly license is a curated species_transfer_rationale on the IHH-NR2F2-BMP2 assertions it genuinely covers.

title: The antiproliferative action of progesterone in uterine epithelium is mediated by Hand2
key_use: Mouse PR-Cre conditional Hand2 knockout; FULL TEXT INSPECTED 2026-07-30. Progesterone induces stromal Hand2 (absent in PR-null uteri); Hand2 deletion derepresses stromal Fgf1, Fgf2, Fgf9 and Fgf18, raises ERalpha Ser118 phosphorylation and E-responsive genes in luminal epithelium, sustains epithelial Ki-67 proliferation into day 4, leaves Muc-1 persistently expressed, leaves blastocysts unattached and makes the females infertile. This is the sole source for the aggregate node S_FGF_MITOGENIC and for LE092/LE093/LE094. Caveats first: entirely mouse in vivo, so every use is a species transfer; the FGF derepression is a transcript profile plus real-time PCR readout of stromal cells, with NO FGF add-back, no FGFR blockade and no individual-FGF knockdown, so the causal step from FGF to epithelial proliferation is inferred from the correlation of the two phenotypes in the same mutant, not demonstrated. The node is therefore an aggregate of four genes that were never separated, and REF-062 (Murata 2019) shows that in human ESC only FGF9 is progestin-regulated while FGF1, FGF2, FGF7 and FGF18 are not - so the aggregate does not transfer as an aggregate. Hbegf is unchanged or slightly reduced in the mutant, an explicit null. Scope limits that are load-bearing for citation: Bmp2 occurs ZERO times and COUP-TFII/COUP occurs ZERO times in the full text; Nr2f2 appears once and Ihh twice, both only as targets reported UNAFFECTED or reduced in the mutant, so this paper cannot support LE003, LE040, LE041, LE043 or LE048 and those citations are retracted. No adhesion assay beyond in vivo attachment scoring; no human tissue of any kind.

Licenses no hCG-to-epithelial-junction edge.

title: Mst1-mediated phosphorylation of Nur77 improves the endometrial receptivity in human and mice
key_use: MST1 phosphorylates NUR77 at T366, raising ITGB3. Its own Fig 2L shows MST1 mediates the E2 plus P4 effect, so this refines an existing edge rather than supplying an ITGB3 input independent of the secretory state. Causal rescue is mouse-only. Fig 1A legend names Nur77 while the panel blots HOXA10.

title: ST6GALNAC1-mediated sialylation in uterine endometrial epithelium facilitates the epithelium-embryo attachment

The strongest candidate for an attachment route that bypasses the LIF-gated integrin bottleneck. Blocked by two gaps: human embryonic SIGLEC6 is scRNA-seq only at low counts with no protein at any stage, and the human-cell ST6GALNAC1 shRNA appears in Methods but no knockdown result is reported. Mouse arm uses Siglec-G, a different gene from primate-specific SIGLEC6.

title: Secretory proteomic responses of endometrial epithelial cells to trophoblast-derived extracellular vesicles
key_use: Hypothesis source only for trophoblast-EV to maternal-secretome signalling, with a genuine HEK293 EV specificity control and an orthogonal MFGE8 ELISA. Licenses no edge: there is no adhesion assay of any kind, and every KEGG pathway in Table 1 is non-significant at FDR 0.40 to 0.94, with Tight junction at FDR 0.94 despite being captioned as p at or below 0.05.

title: Par3/integrin beta1 regulates embryo adhesion via changing endometrial luminal epithelium polarity
key_use: PARD3 and ITGB1 act in opposite directions on luminal-epithelial polarity and blastocyst adhesion, with E2 plus P4 lowering PARD3 and raising ITGB1. A directed PARD3 to ITGB1 chain is contradicted by its own Fig 7C, where si-Par3 raises ITGB1; the data support mutual antagonism. The antagonism is inferred across systems, since Par3 is knocked down in HEC-1A and ITGB1 in RL95-2, and the western molecular-weight labels are inconsistent between Fig 6A and Fig 7A.

title: Glucose influences endometrial receptivity to embryo implantation through O-GlcNAcylation-mediated regulation of the cytoskeleton
key_use: Glucose flux through the hexosamine pathway O-GlcNAcylates MYPT1, acting on actomyosin contractility and apical polarity. Arm structure must not be misread: 17 mM is the supraphysiological standard culture medium these cells are adapted to and is the permissive control, while 5 mM is the physiological non-permissive arm. This is not a hyperglycaemia model. MYPT1 itself was never perturbed; that step exists only in the proposed-model figure.

title: Tripeptidyl peptidase I promotes human endometrial epithelial cell adhesive capacity implying a role in receptivity
key_use: TPP1 knockdown reduces epithelial spheroid adhesion, with a compartment-specific NULL in stroma at deeper knockdown. Direction caveat: Results and Fig 3c to 3e show knockdown DECREASES SIRT1, p53 and BCL2, but the Discussion says upregulation. Follow the figures. ITGB3, CD44, CDH1 and LIF are all explicitly unchanged, so whatever TPP1 does it does not act through any node currently in the model.

title: Endometrial extracellular vesicles regulate processes related to embryo development and implantation in human blastocysts
key_use: Direction-of-signalling evidence for maternal EV to human blastocyst. Readout is TRANSCRIPTOMIC ONLY, with no adhesion, attachment or developmental endpoint; the comparator is medium alone, so there is no vesicle-specificity control; and the cargo attribution is a database intersection of two previously published datasets, not a depletion or add-back.

title: Modeling embryo-endometrial interface recapitulating human embryo implantation
key_use: All-human floating assembloid supporting an epithelium-as-barrier plus stromal-requirement architecture. Contains the only genuine standalone XAV939 manipulation in the corpus, and it points the opposite way, suppressing apical-out organoid formation in CHIR99021-containing medium. Its Fig 4E adhesion rate must not constrain the maternal hormone-to-adhesion arm: removing the epithelium doubles adhesion and hormone withdrawal is non-significant. Also supplies a substrate confound for PAEP.

title: Maternal and embryonic signals cause functional differentiation of luminal epithelial cells and receptivity establishment
key_use: Peri-implantation luminal-epithelial state structure with embryo-derived PDGFA and EFNA3/4 inputs. The best available candidate for breaking the single-secretory-state equivalence class, but only if the two embryonic ligands are modelled as separate inputs. Conservation is overstated by the headline: Fig 7C gives 18.6 and 13.3 percent at ligand-receptor level against 40.0 and 36.4 percent at pathway level. All causal evidence is mouse; ligands were predicted, never perturbed.

title: Dysregulated miR-124-3p in endometrial epithelial cells reduces endometrial receptivity by altering polarity and adhesion
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences USA
key_use: miR-124-3p acting on IQGAP1 as an epithelial polarity and adhesion brake, with unusually well matched arms: mouse epithelium-specific overexpression causes implantation failure, and in human primary HEEC an IQGAP1 target-site blocker restores both protein and adhesion. Target evidence is a site blocker rather than a reporter. miR-124-3p has at least twenty downregulated targets, so it is not an IQGAP1-specific perturbation, and the polarity and adhesion readouts were measured in different cell types.

title: Epidermal growth factor and sex steroids dynamically regulate a marker of endometrial receptivity in Ishikawa cells
journal: Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism
key_use: Sex steroids and EGF-family ligands act in OPPOSITE directions on the ITGB3 subunit in Ishikawa cells. E2 alone and E2 plus P4 both LOWER surface beta3 (prose says 45 and 75 percent; the Fig 2 panel reads about 52 and 71 percent and carries no error bars, no n and no significance test), while EGF (1 ng/mL), TGFA (5 ng/mL) or bFGF (10 ng/mL) each raise it about 2.2 to 2.6-fold and OVERRIDE the E2 plus P4 suppression from 0.5 ng/mL upward. P4 alone was NEVER measured - stated as not shown, with no bar in Fig 2 and no lane in Fig 4 - so it must not be recorded as a verified null; a null would be expected anyway because Ishikawa PGR is oestrogen-induced. Measures the beta3 SUBUNIT only, using beta3-directed antibodies AP3 and SSA6 and a beta3 cDNA probe; the Fig 2 panel title itself reads Ishikawa Beta 3 while the caption says alphavbeta3. ITGAV and ITGB5 were never measured and heterodimer specificity is asserted by citation, so this supports the ITGB3 arm of the E_ITGAVB3_5 measurement proxy and not a heterodimer or ITGB5 claim. CORROBORATES the position already recorded in topology exemption PAR-002, that progesterone is not a verified direct inducer of ITGB3, and conflicts with no cited relation because the E_SECRETORY_STATE to E_ITGAVB3_5 dependency carries no edge id. Context-dependence is essential: this is 6-day CONTINUOUS steroid exposure, whereas the paper's own Discussion argues in vivo alphavbeta3 rises only after epithelial ER and PR are downregulated, a step the model does not represent. Direction is opposite to Cai 2023 (REF-048) at bibliography level only; neither reference is cited by any edge, so no relation is affected. Licenses no adhesion edge: there is no attachment, adhesion or embryo assay of any kind, and replication is triplicate technical determinations rather than independent biological replicates. HB-EGF, EREG and AREG were not tested - HB-EGF appears only in the reference list - so it cannot support LE018. The Northern EGF arm is a TIME course at one fixed 10 ng/mL dose, so the transcriptional dose-dependence claimed in the Results and Discussion is not demonstrated, although the Fig 5 flow-cytometry dose response is genuine.

title: Embryo-derived human chorionic gonadotropin promotes human decidualization through activating epithelial prostaglandin F2alpha secretion
key_use: Epithelium-mediated route from hCG to a stromal decidual readout, whose cross-compartment step is a genuine transfer experiment: 5 ug/mL hCG on Ishikawa for 1 h, then non-contact pillar-suspended coculture with T-HESC CRL-4003 under db-cAMP plus MPA raises stromal IGFBP1 and cAMP, and siEREG or siHB-EGF in the EPITHELIAL cells returns IGFBP1 to the decidualization-alone level. CRITICAL: the full hCG to PGF2a to EREG/HB-EGF chain was NEVER tested end to end. It is assembled from separate sufficiency experiments, and no arm applies hCG under PGF2a-receptor blockade or COX inhibition, so PGF2a mediation of the hCG effect is inferred rather than shown. What the siRNA licenses is necessity of epithelial EREG and HB-EGF for the INCREMENT above an already-running decidualization protocol, not for decidualization itself: there is no knockdown-without-stimulus arm, no rescue, one siRNA per gene, and knockdown was validated at mRNA level only. ADAM17 was never perturbed and appears only as a single 120 kDa species with no smaller processed form resolved, so this paper licenses no ADAM17 node, edge or shedding mechanism - which is a statement about this paper, not about ADAM17 biology generally. LHCGR is not mentioned anywhere in the full text, so the receptor transducing hCG here is unidentified and no LHCGR edge is licensed. Both compartments are immortalised lines, and there is no adhesion, attachment or embryo endpoint, so nothing here constrains the epithelial attachment arm. Its own Fig 6 puts AKR1C3, PTGFR, EREG and HB-EGF at maximum at LH+2 and near baseline by LH+7, before an embryo exists, so the route cannot be sited in the mid-secretory window on this evidence. AREG at 50 ng/mL is an explicit NULL on IGFBP1 and PRL, with no reagent-bioactivity control. Data-integrity flag: Fig 4M-P is labelled 100 nM PGF2a in-panel and in the Results but 1 nM in the caption for N, O and P, and AL-8810 there is 50 uM against 1 uM in Figs 2H, 2O and 3A, though it does return each readout to the decidualization-alone level rather than below it.

title: SOX4 facilitates PGR protein stability and FOXO1 expression conducive for human endometrial decidualization
key_use: Human primary source for the SOX4-HERC4-PGR-FOXO1 stromal arm, and the only route into FOXO1 in this corpus that is not mouse. Caveats first: every causal experiment is siRNA knockdown or overexpression in cultured human endometrial stromal cells under an already-running P4 plus cAMP decidualization protocol, so what is shown is a requirement for the INCREMENT above that protocol, not for decidualization itself; there is no in vivo arm and no embryo, adhesion or attachment endpoint of any kind, so nothing here constrains the epithelial compartment. FOXO1 is placed downstream of SOX4 by a whole-genome SOX4 binding assay plus RNA-seq; HERC4 is identified by immunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry and PGR stabilisation is inferred from ubiquitination, so SOX4 both sits downstream of P4-PGR and stabilises PGR - a mutually reinforcing loop the model cannot encode acyclically without choosing a direction the paper does not settle. The recurrent-implantation-failure and endometriosis link is correlative patient-cohort expression with no implantation outcome measured. Licenses at most a stromal S_SOX4 and S_FOXO1 candidate pair; it does not license FOXO1 sufficiency for PRL or IGFBP1, and it must never be read as an epithelial relation.

title: Importance of CEBPbeta binding and histone acetylation status in the promoter regions for induction of IGFBP-1, PRL and Mn-SOD by cAMP in human endometrial stromal cells
key_use: Chromatin-competence evidence for the cAMP arm of the stromal decidual program: db-cAMP raises IGFBP-1 and PRL mRNA together with CEBPbeta promoter occupancy and H3K27ac, and CEBPbeta knockdown abolishes BOTH the mRNA induction and the H3K27ac gain. Caveats first: the stimulus is db-cAMP ALONE with no progestin arm anywhere in the paper, so it can say nothing about S_PGR, MPA or a combined protocol, and it cannot separate PKA from EPAC because no PKA-selective inhibitor and no CREB perturbation is used - the same limitation exemption PAR-004 already records against S_PKA to S_BMP2, which this paper therefore does not repair. Readouts are mRNA and ChIP only: no protein, no secretion, no morphological decidual endpoint, no embryo or adhesion assay. Mn-SOD dissociates within the paper - its intronic-enhancer H3K27ac is already high before cAMP, is not further raised by cAMP, and is not lowered by CEBPbeta knockdown even though the mRNA still falls - so histone acetylation and transcription come apart in the authors' own data and must not be lumped into one chromatin-competence node. Cells are proliferative-phase ESC from women aged 40 to 45 operated for myoma uteri or early-stage cervical cancer.

title: Progestin-induced heart and neural crest derivatives-expressed transcript 2 inhibits angiopoietin 2 via fibroblast growth factor 9 in human endometrial stromal cells
key_use: The human counterpart of the mouse HAND2-to-FGF relation the model currently encodes on mouse evidence alone (LE092). In primary human ESC, E2 plus MPA (MPA 10^-7 mol/L, 3 days) lowers FGF9 mRNA and secreted protein, RU486 blocks that effect, and two independent HAND2 siRNAs raise FGF9 under E2 plus MPA; recombinant FGF9 then activates FGF receptor signalling and raises ANGPT2 and the ANGPT2/ANGPT1 ratio. Caveats first, and they decide how it may be used: of six endometrial FGF genes measured, ONLY FGF9 was significantly progestin-regulated - FGF1, FGF2, FGF7 and FGF18 were measured and did not move - so this is a NEGATIVE result against an aggregate stromal mitogenic FGF node, not human support for one. The downstream readout is ANGPT2 and vascular maturation, not epithelial proliferation: FGF9 was never applied to any epithelial cell, no epithelium appears anywhere in the paper, and there is no proliferation, receptivity, adhesion or embryo endpoint, so it cannot support LE093 (S_FGF_MITOGENIC to E_ESTROGENIC_PROLIFERATION) in any form. n is 4 to 5 different primary cell preparations per panel. HAND2 is never shown to bind the FGF9 locus, so the suppression is indirect as far as this paper goes.

title: Interleukin-11 enhances cell survival of decidualized normal human endometrial stromal cells
key_use: Local IL-11 as a survival input to already-decidualizing human stroma. Caveats first: the effect is strictly CONDITIONAL - IL-11 raises viability and prolactin secretion in 8-Br-cAMP-stimulated cells and has NO effect on unstimulated stromal cells, an explicit null that forbids encoding IL-11 as an independent driver of decidualization. A second internal dissociation matters as much: in the co-stimulation arm IL-11 raises viability dose-dependently with no significant effect on prolactin, so viability and the decidual marker separate inside one paper and must not share a node. Readouts are cell viability and secreted PRL only; there is no defined apoptotic challenge, no IL-11 receptor perturbation, no neutralising antibody, no gp130 or STAT3 measurement, and no embryo, attachment or implantation endpoint - the mouse Il11ra-null implantation phenotype is cited as motivation and is not reproduced here. Varying the extracellular matrix made no difference, a further recorded null. Cells were maintained more than four weeks before decidualization, so passage-related drift is uncontrolled. Licenses at most a catalog-only stromal survival module conditional on a running cAMP program; it licenses no edge into any receptivity or adhesion output.

title: Organoid co-culture model of the human endometrium in a fully synthetic extracellular matrix enables the study of epithelial-stromal crosstalk
key_use: The only fully defined, Matrigel-free epithelial-stromal co-culture platform in the corpus: human endometrial stromal cells and epithelial organoids co-encapsulated in a PEG hydrogel crosslinked with MMP-labile peptides and functionalised with GFOGER and PHSRN-K-RGD, responding to a simulated menstrual cycle. Caveats first: it is a platform and characterisation paper. Hormone responses are morphological and marker-level - stromal PRL secretion, gland maturation, vimentin morphology - with NO embryo, blastoid, spheroid or adhesion endpoint of any kind, so it licenses no attachment relation and cannot calibrate any adhesion readout. Its single crosstalk result is inflammatory rather than physiological: IL1B at 1 ng/mL suppresses stromal DNA synthesis (EdU) and PRL secretion and dysregulates epithelial proliferation via the stroma, at n=3 - a candidate stroma-to-epithelium proliferation control obtained under a cytokine challenge, not under a cycle signal. Matrix stiffness, adhesion-peptide identity and composition were selected semi-empirically to make the culture work, so every quantitative behaviour is matrix-conditioned and not transferable to the ADOC chip without re-derivation. The integrin panel used to choose those peptides is scRNA-seq expression from 6 donors and 6,659 cells - expression, never function.

title: Cellular and molecular responses of the uterus to embryo implantation can be elicited by locally applied growth factors
journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences USA
key_use: Mouse in vivo demonstration that a locally applied growth factor can substitute for the blastocyst, and the source of the strongest NEGATIVE in the corpus about BMP2. Affi-Gel beads preabsorbed with HB-EGF or IGF-1 and transferred into day-4 pseudopregnant uteri (seven beads per horn) reproduce localized vascular permeability, decidualization and stromal Bmp2 induction, whereas beads carrying BSA, EGF, TGFalpha, epiregulin, BMP2, BMP4 or SHH do not. Caveats first: it is entirely mouse in vivo, so any use is a species transfer against a human target model. The result that bears on the current architecture is the negative one - BMP2 beads do NOT themselves elicit an implantation response and only alter the spacing of blastocyst-induced sites when co-transferred - so this paper must never be cited as evidence of BMP2 sufficiency for decidualization, which is what a naive reading of S_BMP2 to S_DECIDUALIZED would take from it. The stromal Bmp2, Fgf2 and Wnt4 induction at the attachment site is in situ hybridisation expression, not a causal relation, and under the repository invariant must not become an edge. Beads are not embryos: loading was not converted to a delivered dose, release kinetics are unmeasured, and there is no receptor-level or blocking arm anywhere.

title: Regional specialization of the cell membrane-associated, polymorphic mucin (MUC1) in human uterine epithelia
key_use: The direct human counter-evidence to any global MUC1-falls-at-receptivity rule, and therefore to LE013 as encoded. Using endometrial tissue in which the luminal epithelium is identifiable, with CT-1 against the MUC1 cytoplasmic tail and HMFG-1 and HMFG-2 against two ectodomain epitopes, MUC1 core protein is MAINTAINED in the human luminal epithelium throughout the cycle INCLUDING the mid-luteal receptive phase; what changes is that the HMFG-1 ectodomain epitope becomes undetectable and can be RESTORED by keratanase or neuraminidase predigestion, i.e. regionally restricted glycosylation masks the protein core rather than removing the protein. Caveats first: this is descriptive immunohistochemistry with staining-ratio semiquantification and small numbers (mid-luteal n=5 patients), no perturbation of any kind, no adhesion or embryo assay, and no functional test of whether the altered glycoform helps or hinders attachment - the authors explicitly leave open both that MUC1 must be locally removed and that it actively promotes the first adhesive steps. It bears on GAP-004, which already records that abundance, glycosylation and spatial clearance are not equivalent. It is evidence that the single-abundance reading of E_MUC1_BARRIER is wrong; it is not evidence for a replacement rule and must not be used to flip the sign of LE013. Note the contrast the paper itself draws: the luminal MUC1 decline this model inherited is a mouse, baboon, pig, rat and rabbit finding, not a human one.

title: The effects of sex steroid hormones and interleukin-1-beta on MUC1 expression in endometrial epithelial cell lines
key_use: Cell-line evidence that progesterone UP-regulates endometrial epithelial MUC1 - the opposite sign to LE013 (E_SECRETORY_STATE inhibits E_MUC1_BARRIER). Four endometrial epithelial lines (HEC1A ER-positive and PR-positive, HEC1B ER-positive and PR-negative, Ishikawa, RL95-2) treated with oestrogen and progesterone with or without interleukin-1-beta, read by immunocytochemistry and flow cytometry, plus a MUC1-promoter CAT reporter transfected into HEC1A and HEC1B. Caveats first: these are carcinoma lines with heterogeneous and in one case absent receptor status, unpolarised, with no primary epithelium, no apical or basolateral resolution, and no adhesion, spheroid or embryo endpoint whatsoever, so this cannot license a receptivity claim in either direction. The two explicit NULLS carry as much weight as the positive result: oestrogen does not modulate MUC1, and interleukin-1-beta does not either - the paper's own stated hypothesis failing, which removes the embryo-derived IL-1 route it set out to test. Its own introduction records that the in vitro literature on progesterone and MUC1 is conflicting. Read with REF-067 the conclusion is that the model's MUC1 branch is under-specified rather than merely mis-signed: abundance may rise under progestin while the ectodomain becomes less accessible, and one Boolean node cannot carry both.

title: Hormonal effects of PGF2alpha output by cultures of epithelial and stromal cells in human endometrium
key_use: The oldest primary source in the corpus and the only compartment-resolved measurement of endometrial PGF2alpha output. In primary cultures from human endometrium, basal PGF2alpha output is similar in glandular epithelium and stroma, but estradiol (10^-7 M and 10^-8 M) raises it ONLY in the epithelial cells (7 and 8 specimens in the two experiments; the 2.0-fold plus or minus 0.5 change in stroma is not significant). Tamoxifen and trans-4-hydroxytamoxifen do not alter basal output but block the estradiol effect, OHTam being at least ten times more potent - the entire basis for the receptor-mediated claim, which is pharmacological and indirect. Progesterone (10^-7 M) INHIBITS PGF2alpha output in secretory endometrium in organ culture, and inhibits lipocortin at the same time, so the authors explicitly state that the lipocortin mechanism they tested does NOT explain the progesterone effect and that the mechanism remains unknown. Caveats first: 1986 methods, PGF2alpha by radioimmunoassay on culture medium, per-figure n at specimen level and not stated for every panel, no significance test reported for most figures, no receptor measurement, no PTGFR arm, no epithelial-to-stromal transfer experiment and no embryo or adhesion endpoint. This is the recorded CONTRADICTION against REF-059 (Jin 2025), which routes hCG through epithelial PGF2alpha to a stromal decidual readout under db-cAMP plus MPA: Schatz says progestin SUPPRESSES the epithelial PGF2alpha source in primary cells, so Jin asserts that route precisely in the hormonal context in which this paper says the source is down. The two are not directly comparable - primary glandular epithelium and organ culture versus Ishikawa, steroid alone versus 5 ug/mL hCG, and nearly four decades of assay change - so this is registered as an unresolved conflict, not as a refutation of either paper.

title: Mechanism of human chorionic gonadotropin in endometrial receptivity via the miR-126-3p/PI3K/Akt/eNOS axis
key_use: Registered so a real tension is recorded, not because it licenses anything. DEDUPLICATION HAZARD FIRST: this is the second Wang 2023 in this bibliography and must never be merged with REF-056 (Wang 2023, Developmental Cell, 10.1016/j.devcel.2023.08.004) - different authors, different journal, different biology. The in vivo system is a mifepristone-induced embryo-implantation-dysfunction mouse, so organism-level results are obtained under PGR blockade, the perturbation the model encodes as IN_MIFEPRISTONE, and those arms cannot be read as normal physiology. The human arm is cultured human endometrial epithelial cells with no adhesion, attachment or embryo endpoint. The core problem for the model is the paper's operational definition of improved receptivity: INCREASED epithelial proliferation (CCK-8 and EdU) plus endothelial CD105, CD144 and CD146. That is in direct tension with REF-028 (Li 2011), where progesterone-driven TERMINATION of epithelial proliferation is a prerequisite for implantation and persistent proliferation causes implantation failure, and the model encodes the latter (E_ESTROGENIC_PROLIFERATION inhibits E_RECEPTIVE_SURFACE, LE095). The miR-126-3p to PIK3R2 relation rests on prediction plus a reporter; no hCG receptor is identified anywhere; the rescue is a miR-126 inhibitor, not a PIK3R2 add-back. Licenses no edge in either direction; it is a recorded conflict about what receptivity means.

title: Embryo secretome regulation of the endometrial epithelial transcriptome: development of a model to test for embryo viability
key_use: Direction-of-signalling evidence from embryo secretome to human endometrial epithelium in a defined organoid system: single-cell-derived endometrial epithelial organoids stimulated with spent culture supernatants from morphologically good-quality blastocysts of known outcome (live birth n=4 versus no pregnancy n=4) give 32 differentially expressed genes, 24 up and 8 down, enriched for cell motility and cytoskeletal terms. Caveats first: the readout is TRANSCRIPTOMIC ONLY - no adhesion, attachment, invasion, barrier or any functional endpoint - so it licenses no edge, exactly as REF-054 does not. The organoids derive from ONE parous 39-year-old donor, so donor identity, organoid line and model system are completely confounded and no donor-variability statement is possible; GAP-008 applies in full. Four versus four embryos with 32 DEGs is a small unreplicated discovery experiment with no independent validation cohort, and the group labels are the clinical outcomes of transferred embryos, not a controlled property of the supernatant. A medium confound sits underneath every comparison: the paper reports that embryo culture medium ITSELF suppresses organoid proliferation, which the authors attribute to lower growth-factor concentrations rather than to embryo signals. Hormone responsiveness of the organoids is evidenced by SPP1 and acetyl-alpha-tubulin only. Do not confuse with REF-059 (Jin 2025, Molecular and Cellular Endocrinology, hCG and PGF2alpha) - different group, different DOI, different biology.

title: Interleukin-11 and leukemia inhibitory factor regulate the adhesion of endometrial epithelial cells: implications in fertility regulation
key_use: IL-11 and LIF both raise primary human EEC adhesion to fibronectin and collagen IV and both raise integrin-alpha2 mRNA and protein, yet dissociate on phenotype: IL-11 stimulates trophoblast attachment where LIF does not, and alpha2beta1 neutralization reduces the LIF but NOT the IL-11 collagen-IV response.

title: Regulation of decidualization in human endometrial stromal cells through exchange protein directly activated by cyclic AMP (Epac)
key_use: EPAC-selective cAMP analogue alone is inert, potentiates the PKA-selective analogue and activates RAP1; EPAC1/EPAC2/RAP1 knockdown inhibits the PKA-driven IGFBP-1 and PRL response. cAMP is not equivalent to PKA and the second arm is cooperative.

title: Insulin-like growth factor binding protein-1 induces decidualization of human endometrial stromal cells via alpha5beta1 integrin
key_use: Recombinant IGFBP-1 induces decidualization of human ESC in the ABSENCE of MPA and E2; an RGD peptide blocks it and is inert alone; anti-alpha5beta1 blocks IGFBP-1 binding to the cell surface. NOTE decidualization was scored by morphology AND PRL release, so PRL is the READOUT of decidualization here and no separate direct IGFBP-1 -> PRL edge is established.

title: Indian hedgehog and its targets in human endometrium: menstrual cycle expression and response to CDB-2914
journal: Journal of Clinical Endocrinology and Metabolism
key_use: Human endometrium, compartment-resolved (epithelial glands and stroma, nuclei and cytoplasm scored separately): IHH, PTCH1, SMO, GLI1 and GLI2 across the menstrual cycle, with IHH and GLI1 rising in the secretory phase. The selective progesterone receptor modulator CDB-2914 up-regulated IHH 5.2-fold and GLI1 3.6-fold after 3 months. GLI1 is the canonical Hedgehog pathway-ACTIVITY readout, so this is human in vivo evidence that Hedgehog OUTPUT is progestin-responsive in endometrium -- not merely that the components are present.

title: Jagged1 regulates endometrial receptivity in both humans and mice
key_use: JAG1 siRNA reduces trophoblast-spheroid adhesion in primary human endometrial epithelial cells and in Ishikawa; NOTCH3 NICD falls as measured pathway activity while NOTCH1/2 NICD rise; MAML1-dependence isolates SPP1 alone among five receptivity markers; PGR and ESR1 unchanged in human. No hormonal or contextual input to JAG1 is perturbed anywhere in the paper.

title: Sialyl Lewis X mediates interleukin-1 beta-induced trophoblast adhesion to endometrial cells during human embryo implantation
key_use: IL-1beta raises surface sLeX via FUT3 in RL95-2 and raises HTR-8/SVneo spheroid adhesion; anti-sLeX blockade and FUT3 siRNA each reduce it. FUT3 rises while ST3GAL3/4 and FUT4/7 fall under the same stimulus. No viability or proliferation control anywhere; single IL-1beta concentration.

title: Progestins regulate the expression and activity of the forkhead transcription factor FOXO1 in differentiating human endometrium
key_use: Primary human endometrial stromal cells: FOXO1 nuclear versus cytoplasmic localisation measured AS localisation, by confocal immunofluorescence and by cytosolic/nuclear fractionation Western. 8-br-cAMP alone leaves FOXO1 nuclear; adding MPA gives cytoplasmic retention WITH DISCRETE RESIDUAL NUCLEAR FOCI; the route is PI3K/Akt and LY294002 reverses it; MPA withdrawal restores nuclear FOXO1 within 1 h. The combination arm 8-br-cAMP PLUS MPA IS tested. Supplies the localisation determinant the S_FOXO1 row lacked, so section 5(2) clears and the node then fails at 5(4). No E2 and no XAV939 arm, so this is not the ADOC cocktail; attenuation, not abolition.

title: Forkhead transcription factor FOXO1A is critical for induction of human decidualization
key_use: FOXO1A siRNA lowers BOTH prolactin and IGFBP-1 together with EBAF, TIMP-3 and somatostatin. CAUTION: the cells are human decidual fibroblasts dissected from the CHORIONIC LAYER OF PLACENTA, i.e. gestational, despite a title that says 'human decidualization'; the readout is FOXO1A abundance, not localisation. Registered as one of the placental-context corrections, and as evidence that PRL and IGFBP-1 move together here.

title: FOXO1A differentially regulates genes of decidualization
key_use: FOXO1A siRNA in primary non-pregnant human endometrial stromal cells DECREASES IGFBP1 and DCN while INCREASING PRL, TIMP3 and CNR1; FOXO1A overexpression raises IGFBP1, PRL and DCN. The strongest corpus evidence that S_PRL and S_IGFBP1 are separable. CAUTION: the authors state the siRNA also targets FOXO3A, so the PRL rise cannot be attributed to FOXO1A alone, and knockdown and overexpression give opposite PRL signs.

title: Dysregulation of in vitro decidualization of human endometrial stromal cells by insulin via transcriptional inhibition of forkhead box protein O1
key_use: FOXO1 ACTIVITY inhibition (AS1842856, 100 nM) under MPA plus db-cAMP collapses IGFBP1 (FC 0.13, p<0.05) while PRL is unchanged (FC 1.1, NS, n=6, range 51.8-172.0); insulin lowers IGFBP1 dose-dependently and RAISES PRL 3.0-fold, and drives FOXO1 nuclear export via PI3K (wortmannin rescue). Makes the two analytes biologically non-identical under one perturbation. The PRL arm is a NULL, not a measured invariance, and insulin is in no ADOC condition.

title: Role of FOXO1A in the regulation of insulin-like growth factor-binding protein-1 in human endometrial cells: interaction with progesterone receptor
key_use: FOXO1A and PGR physically interact and each modulates the other's transactivation; liganded PGR is recruited to the IGFBP1 promoter -358 to -49 by ChIP. The interaction sign is CELL-TYPE DEPENDENT - FOXO1A inhibits the PGRB response in HuF but synergises in HEC-1B - and in HuF the combination is sub-additive, 'not additive but lower than the sum of individual responses'. So FOXO1 x PGR is encodable as neither AND nor OR. CAUTION: HuF cells are from DECIDUA PARIETALIS OF TERM PLACENTAL MEMBRANES despite the abstract calling them endometrial; PRL is not measured. The held file is an NIH Public Access AUTHOR MANUSCRIPT, not the version of record.

title: HoxA-11 and FOXO1A cooperate to regulate decidual prolactin expression: towards inferring the core transcriptional regulators of decidual genes
key_use: FOXO1A ALONE is inert on the decidual PRL enhancer; HoxA-11 alone represses; only HoxA-11 plus FOXO1A activate (>3-fold). HoxA-10 plus FOXO1A FAILS on dPRL although HoxA-10 is the paralog that cooperates with FOXO1A on IGFBP-1 - a cis-level dissociation of the two branches. Makes S_PRL = f(S_FOXO1) positively wrong rather than merely unsupported. CAUTION: every load-bearing reporter and interaction result is in HeLa; the endometrial cells are telomerase-immortalised (CRL-4003), not primary.

title: Calpain7 negatively regulates human endometrial stromal cell decidualization in EMs by promoting FoxO1 nuclear exclusion via hydrolyzing AKT1
key_use: CAPN7 hydrolyses AKT1 and enhances its phosphorylation, driving FoxO1 Ser319 phosphorylation, nuclear exclusion and attenuated transcriptional activity in primary decidualising human endometrial stromal cells. The AKT-specific primary human source the S_AKT_EXCESS row asks for, and independent support for the PI3K/Akt route in REF-078. CAUTION: the paper's frame is ENDOMETRIOSIS and its in vivo arm is MOUSE; CAPN7 is not an agent, state or input in any ADOC condition, so it supplies no ADOC-addressable exposure.

title: Human endometrial mucin MUC1 is up-regulated by progesterone and down-regulated in vitro by the human blastocyst
key_use: In vivo in 10 agonadal oocyte-donation recipients: PROGESTERONE UP-REGULATES MUC1 (twofold mRNA rise in receptive versus non-receptive endometrium, p<0.05; apical protein after 6 d of P), and blastocyst apposition raises it further by >2-fold. MUC1 removal is STRICTLY LOCAL, only from epithelium subjacent and adjacent to the attached embryo, with cytokeratin confirming the epithelium is intact. CONTRADICTS the committed rule E_MUC1_BARRIER = not E_SECRETORY_STATE. Licenses a SPLIT of abundance from local clearance, NOT a sign flip; local mechanism undetermined; n=3 attachment sites.

title: MUC16 is lost from the uterodome (pinopode) surface of the receptive human endometrium: in vitro evidence that MUC16 is a barrier to trophoblast adherence
key_use: At MATCHED knockdown efficiency (86-87%), MUC16 knockdown gives approximately 3.8-fold more trophoblast-line adhesion (p<0.01, n=6) while MUC1 knockdown gives no significant difference. MUC16 is absent from uterodome surfaces in 12 of 12 receptive biopsies; MUC1 is on the luminal surface in 12 of 12 but ON UTERODOMES IN ONLY 4 OF 12. Undermines MUC1 as the antiadhesive member and marks MUC16 as a later candidate. Causal arm is cell line on cell line at 1 h.

title: Bone morphogenetic protein 2 functions via a conserved signaling pathway involving Wnt4 to regulate uterine decidualization in the mouse and the human
key_use: Recombinant BMP2 added ON TOP of a complete hormone mixture (0.5 mM 8-bromo-cAMP, 1 uM P, 10 nM E) further stimulates human stromal differentiation and raises Wnt4. Falsifies the committed degeneracy S_BMP2 = S_PGR, which exhaustive enumeration of the v0.5.0 network confirms is an exact identity. SUPPLIES NO REPLACEMENT: there is no progestin-free human arm and every causal knockdown uses MOUSE siRNA in MOUSE cells.

title: Reduced signaling through the hedgehog pathway in the uterine stroma causes deferred implantation and embryonic loss
key_use: Stroma-restricted conditional Smo deletion in mouse defers implantation and raises embryo resorption at days 13-15, reducing litter size 60%. The best available anchor for a reception-necessity argument and still NOT sufficient for GAP-014: mouse; only a 49% Smo reduction, so not a necessity test; day-7 implantation site number did NOT differ; NR2F2 and HAND2 are never measured.

title: Cleavage of endometrial alpha-integrins into their functional forms is mediated by proprotein convertase 5/6
key_use: PC6 mediates post-translational cleavage of pro-integrin-alpha5 and pro-integrin-alphaV into functional subunits, validated in PRIMARY human endometrial epithelial cells (with a PC6 inhibitor, not siRNA). PC6 knockdown in HEC1A reduces surface a1, a2, a5, aV and aVb5 and reduces spheroid attachment and fibronectin binding, while a5b1, a4 AND aVb3 DID NOT SIGNIFICANTLY DIFFER. The committed node E_ITGAVB3_5 merges b3 and b5, so a PC6 edge to it would be mis-specified; splitting b3 from b5 is a prerequisite for using this paper at all.

title: TGFbeta1 attenuates expression of prolactin and IGFBP-1 in decidualized endometrial stromal cells by both SMAD-dependent and SMAD-independent pathways
key_use: TGFbeta1 down-regulates PRL, IGFBP-1 and tissue factor in primary non-pregnant endometrial stromal cells, and SMAD4 knockdown ABROGATES the effect on PRL but does NOT fully restore IGFBP-1 - the two markers are separable by MECHANISM even when they move in the same direction. First-trimester decidual stromal cells are more refractory than non-pregnant ESC. This is the claim config/coupling_adjudication.tsv row S_PRL and docs/coupling_adjudication.md section 3.2 have been leaning on in prose since before any ledger row existed; registering it closes that provenance gap. TGFbeta1 is not an ADOC agent and this is not a Boolean rule.

title: FOXO1 is required for binding of PR on IRF4, novel transcriptional regulator of endometrial stromal decidualization
key_use: FOXO1 is REQUIRED for PR binding at the interval downstream of IRF4 - FOXO1 licenses progesterone-receptor genomic action, a step the committed model represents nowhere - and the paper's own fractionation shows most FOXO1 is cytoplasmic with a residual nuclear fraction under E2 + MPA + db-cAMP, an almost-ADOC condition. CAUTION: the strong IGFBP1/PRL/WNT4 attenuation in this paper is the IRF4 knockdown (Figure 6B); under FOXO1 knockdown the main text says only that IGFBP-1 and PRL are 'differentially regulated' (Supplemental Figure 2), with no direction stated and no RT-qPCR validation, and that supplement is not in the held file.
